title: Дебаты: "Жизнь сегодня" (Монолог)
description: Мини-выступление «Как изменилась жизнь подростков», минимум 2 раза Present Perfect Continuous.

conditions.label: Минимум 2 раза Present Perfect Continuous
conditions.hint: Teenagers have been using smartphones more often.

conditions.label: Лексика подростков и технологий
conditions.hint: smartphones, the Internet, social media, online

monologue:
Now teenagers live in a very different world. They have been using smartphones every day for many years, and they have been spending a lot of time on social media. Because of this, they communicate online more than before.

Before, teenagers met friends in the streets, talked face to face and played outside. Now they often chat, play games and watch videos online. The Internet has changed how they study, relax and make friends.

Teenagers have been getting information from the Internet instead of books, and they have been learning new skills from online courses. Life is faster and more connected now. Before, it was slower and simpler. Now, teenagers are always online, but they also have more opportunities.
